answers.reason: The senate decides on matters of the whole university, and research staff do not belong to the university leadership.
A budget planning round allocates funds, which is handled by administration and leadership rather than research staff.
An appointment committee selects candidates for professorships, not a matter for research staff.
A faculty council decides on the affairs of a specific faculty, and research staff are not listed as participants in faculty councils.
An examination board decides on examination matters of individual students, which is handled by administration rather than research staff.
